title: The Domain of the Mind
coreMove: Mental stillness is a pause before judgment: steady the room, rank the real risks, and let facts settle before fear writes the plan everyone will follow.

exampleSpecs.domain: airport operations during a cancelled flight
exampleSpecs.audience: readers who need a fast reset before their tone spreads
exampleSpecs.stakes: one loud announcement can turn a delay into a crowd problem
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the pause itself changes the next action, so the reader sees mental stillness as a reset before speech

exampleSpecs.domain: clothing store fitting room after a rush
exampleSpecs.audience: readers whose minds make small messes feel large
exampleSpecs.stakes: mental clutter can turn one ordinary room into a false emergency
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the detail of the small room teaches how interpretation enlarges raw circumstance

exampleSpecs.domain: nursery handoff after a hard night
exampleSpecs.audience: readers reviewing a mistake after the outcome is already known
exampleSpecs.stakes: a rushed mind can hide the actual cause of a small failure
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the scene opens after the failure and reconstructs what the facts showed

exampleSpecs.domain: rink skate counter during a safety complaint
exampleSpecs.audience: readers who notice their own alarm midstream
exampleSpecs.stakes: one unchecked leap can become policy for the whole rink
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the center is the moment the protagonist notices his own error, not the later fix

exampleSpecs.domain: nursing station during a night shift
exampleSpecs.audience: readers who need to write their way out of first fear
exampleSpecs.stakes: an entire ward can feel unsafe if the first read outruns the chart
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the written artifact carries the action and shows facts settling before judgment

exampleSpecs.domain: print shop cutter table during a rush order
exampleSpecs.audience: readers comparing panic with calm factual sorting
exampleSpecs.stakes: one response creates a client problem while the other saves usable work
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: two people meet the same jam in opposite ways and the outcomes visibly diverge
